response.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM telescopes), groups AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), shares AS (SELECT g.powerstatus, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM groups g CROSS JOIN totals t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_above_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
